candidates.review_note: Respect the explicitly unusual precedence XOR before AND before OR. Precompute maximal XOR blocks and AND groups; XOR prefix sums and range-AND/range-OR trees evaluate full interior blocks. Query endpoints are character positions and may cut a decimal token, so parse the two boundary numeric substrings rather than treating them as whole original operands. Handle same-token, same-XOR-block and same-AND-group cases separately as structural cases, not source-specific exceptions.

Interleave the original string from the left and right ends. A pair of identical outer blocks of length k becomes one even palindrome of length2k, so the desired symmetric even-block partitions correspond bijectively to partitions of this interleaving into even palindromes. Count them with an online palindromic tree and equal-difference series links, retaining zero DP on odd prefix lengths. Series values aggregate the standard palindromic-suffix recurrence without enumerating a quadratic number of repeated-character palindromes; packed arrays bound memory for million-character inputs.
